profile.product: A workspace rental app (Android) where space owners list clinic rooms, therapy rooms, offices, studios, classrooms and meeting rooms, and verified professionals book them by the hour, shift, day, month or per attendee.
profile.category: Room and workspace rental marketplace for space owners
profile.value_proposition: Turn empty rooms into steady income: list every room, rent it by the hour, shift, day, month or per attendee, and accept requests from verified professionals without long leases or double bookings.
profile.paying_customer: Space owners (Pro Hosts) pay for ProHost Premium, a monthly or yearly subscription billed by Google Play, to publish and manage listings. Professionals book for free.
ideal_customer: Hotels with meeting rooms empty on weekdays
Medical centers, polyclinics and private clinics with rooms free part of the day
Training centers, institutes and schools with classrooms free in the evenings and on weekends
Coworking spaces, business centers and office owners with spare desks or offices
Yoga, pilates and dance studios with free hours
Property managers and real estate agencies with vacant commercial units
pain_points: Rooms sit empty for part of the week and earn nothing
The only way to rent space today is a long lease
Phone tag and back-and-forth to arrange short bookings
Double bookings when rooms are tracked by hand
Not knowing who the renter is before they arrive
Changing prices means messaging every tenant
proof_points: Five ways to rent each room: hourly, shift, daily, monthly or per attendee
Accepted bookings lock their slots automatically, so there are no double bookings
Renters have a verified phone number and a profile photo before they can book
One request inbox: accept or decline in a tap, talk on WhatsApp, the host's number is never shown publicly
Change prices now or from the next term; affected tenants are notified automatically
No commission on bookings: Premium is a flat subscription
Occupancy and revenue for every room in one dashboard
Launch offer: 50% off the first Premium subscription
profile.offer: ProHost Premium for space owners, with 50% off the first monthly or yearly subscription
profile.pricing_model: Flat monthly or yearly subscription through Google Play, cancel any time, no booking commission; free for professionals who book
markets: Lebanon: Beirut, Mount Lebanon, Byblos, Tripoli, Saida, Tyre, Zahle, Nabatieh
profile.platforms: Android (Google Play); iPhone app not available yet
not_a_fit: Landlords who only rent homes on long residential leases
Buyers looking for tenant accounting or property management software
Businesses with no rooms, desks or halls to rent
